updatedAt.description: Client time of the edit. Informational only; Nerd Ballot uses its own receipt time for deadlines.

rankedBooks.description: AT-URIs of com.nerdballot.book records, best first. No duplicates.

main.description: One record per track. The record key is {award}-{eligibilityYear}-{category}, for example hugo-2026-novel. Array order is rank order: first earns 5 points, fifth earns 1.

description: A voter's ranked ballot for one Nerd Ballot track. Nerd Ballot is an unofficial community poll, not affiliated with WSFS, Worldcon or SFWA.
